column1: When players win a battle and get loot, they will select 1 Die and then will be presented with 3 options for a New Side to be added to that specific Die. Players can choose to skip, but they can't select a different Die to upgrade
When players see Side rewards, the Sides are rolled 1 by 1 until all 3 are rolled. Then, they're shown to the player
The same Side cannot be duplicated in the rewards set - ie, you won't see 2 options that are identical in the set of 3 options
Some Sides are tagged with a Biome (volcano, swamp, ice cave), but most Sides are non-tagged/normal
If the player is traversing through a Biome and has the opportunity to add a Side, 2 of the 3 Side slots will have that Biome's tag.
If the player added a Side in the most recent upgrade for this Die (didn't skip), 1 of the 3 Side slots will match the Biome tag previously selected
If a slot has no biome tag stipulations, roll 50/50 if the slot will be Neutral or Biome. If Biome, then select randomly from the 3 biome options
Assess if Biome tags must exist, and which slots they will be on (option 1, 2, or 3, equal odds). Then, roll for Level of the Sides
There are 3 levels of Sides, roughly equating to their power

A: Common, good sides that will help build your strategy
Uncommon, great sides that will deal lots of damage or create combos
Rare, unique sides that will form the basis for complex combos and massive damage

column1: The player will start each Chapter with the following base odds for seeing new Sides
Anytime a Level 1 Side is selected (could be up to 3 times per reward...), x increases by 1.
If Level 3 is ever selected, x drops to 0
This x counter continues across the whole Chapter. x resets to 0 at the beginning of new Chapters.
This mechanic ensures players will see Level 3 Sides eventually, but won't be able to spam them.

There might be two Level 3 sides in a single reward but its quite literally 1/100 chance only when the first slot was selected to be L3. (slot 1 select L3, x->0, slot 2 picks something, x->1, slot 3 has 1% chance of picking L3)
Once the Level of the Sides are chosen, roll for the specific Side within that Level.
If the Biome tag was assigned to that slot, only pick from Sides of that Level matching that Biome tag
Give all Sides within the available options a liklihood score of 1
If that specific Die has a specific Side already on it, and that Side is in the available options, increase that Side's liklihood score by 1
If that specific Die has 2 copies of a specific Level 3 Side already on it, drop that Side's liklihood score to 0
Then do a random draw from the total liklihood, selecting 1 Side. (essentially a liklihood score of 2 has double odds of being selected)
Once that Side has been selected, it won't get selected again within the same set of 3, so remove it from the available options
Continue this process until all 3 Sides are selected for the slots. Then show all 3 to the player.
Boss Baddie loot will ALWAYS result in 3 Level 3 Sides offered with +100 points. All other rules remain the same.

After any Baddie Battle or Obelisk, players will have a dynamic % chance of getting a Food. The run starts with base odds of 20% chance. If they do not get a Food, their chance rises 10% for the next reward. If they do get a Food, their chance decreases 10% for the next reward. This continues for the whole run.
If user gets a Food from rewards, it will come from:

If in a Biome, and Food Pool 1 is rolled, roll a 50/50 between Biome Food and Other Food. If Biome Food, choose from the 3 Foods with that Biome tag. If Other Food, choose from all non-Biome Food in Pool 1
Choose rarity first, then select randomly from remaining Trinkets that haven't yet been collected
If Trinket is earned from an Obelisk, it has a 30% chance of being Rare instead of 10%

If in a Biome, and Common is rolled, roll a 50/50 between Biome Trinket and Other Trinket. If Biome Trinket, choose from the 2 Trinkets with that Biome tag. If Other Trinket, choose from all non-Biome Trinkets in Common Pool. If Biome Trinket was selected and both Biome Trinkets have been collected, default to Other Trinket (non-Biome Trinkets in Common Pool)

Once the player is on a new space, the sequence resets. So the majority of the time the player will pay just 2 Time Crystals to re-roll. This sequence is to prevent spamming.

Then, select 1 Side at random and give it a Sale tag. Cut the price by 35% rounded down.
Up to 3 Time Crystals can be purchased
The first Burn purchased in a run costs 6 Health (your burns are paid by blood sacrifice)
Each subsequent Burn purchased in the run costs 3 additional Health (9, 12, 15, etc)
Only 1 Burn can be purchased at that particular Bub's. You'll have to go to another one to get another Burn.
